gate: On each split: >=4 token-valid pairs, binary correct on both endpoints >=0.75, pooled intended semantic full-vocab top1 >=0.5. No individual pair filtering.
causal_plan: All 18 layers: swap last-position MLP write bidirectionally on every discovery pair in gate-passing families. Choose layer with largest mean donor-directed margin change on discovery, then evaluate every transfer pair there. Include same-answer nuisance donors. Whole writes localize only; no semantic unit claim.
full_vocab: Exact retrieval tokens; fixed agreement and sentiment sets inherited from earlier redteam. Context association probes exploratory and ambiguous.
hypotheses: Endpoint competence will vary across families and templates.
Task-changing donors should move answer contrast more than nuisance donors.
A discovery-selected MLP layer will transfer across held-out wording and lexicons.
